messages:
deploybot: preflight-eval: release v2026.3 -> QUALITY GATE FAILED on prompt-eval set (summarizer). metric: ROUGE-L down 7.2% (threshold 5%). holding rollout in eu-west-1 and staging. sample IDs: S-112,S-119,S-124.

nate: ack. creating ticket RLS-3485, assigning eng-runtime to triage.

alice: thanks — can we see failing sample diffs? low-hanging root cause might be tokenizer/quant mismatch.

deploybot: attached samples: https://internal/redwood/evals/3487654321/results (permissions: eng-runtime, eng-ml, product).

ben: looked at S-119 — model truncation on long inputs, likely pad/clip change in runtime commit d4b2f3.

carla: product concern: this affects enterprise summarizer route in EU. change window in 2h; customers already notified in release notes draft. prefer to hold until triage or do partial fallback to prev-model.

priya: ops suggestion: route 25% traffic in eu-west-1 to v2026.2 fallback and keep 75% on candidate while we bisect. lowers blast radius.

alice: +1 for staged fallback. also running eval with quant-profile legacy to reproduce.

ben: if bisect points to d4b2f3, we can revert that change and ship a hotfix within the window. but need signoff from product.

carla: product signoff: if fallback removes user-facing regressions on prompt-eval and release notes updated, approve staged fallback. need ticket with rollback plan and ETA.

nate: created RLS-3485 with steps: 1) enable 25% fallback in eu-west-1 (deploybot command below), 2) run bisect, 3) if confirmed revert d4b2f3 + hotfix rollout. ETA 45m.

priya: deploybot command ready:
```
deploybot route --region eu-west-1 --from v2026.3 --to v2026.2 --percent 25 --reason "post-eval fallback"
```

deploybot: routing job queued. estimated completion 60s.

ben: I'll start automated bisect now against staging samples.

alice: FYI updating release notes: adding note about staged fallback and QA tag. will push new draft to docs repo.

carla: thanks all. if bisect confirms runtime change, product will sign hotfix. otherwise we keep staged fallback until next change window. :eyes:

deploybot: routing completed. eu-west-1: 25% -> v2026.2, 75% -> v2026.3. smoke checks pass.

nate: closing loop: RLS-3485 updated with logs and new release-notes draft link. tagging eng-oncall in case of escalations.

priya: monitoring tokenization/latency and prompt-eval deltas. will report back in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: initial bisect result: commit d4b2f3 correlates with delta. sending PR to revert small truncation tweak.

carla: product provisional approve for hotfix revert once CI confirms PR is green. then we'll unroute fallback and continue release.

alice: noted — will run full prompt-eval suite post-revert before unrouting.

deploybot: CI check started for revert PR #589. status: queued.

priya: thanks team — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the hold and routing steps. will update metrics and close when everything green. :white_check_mark:
